own_scenes.desc: Robert Earle Davis Jr., heredero del mixtapero Darryl Scott, ralentizó los platos para mezclar y scratchear rap a un tempo letárgico y alucinado, a la medida de la calma de la ciudad; desde 1993 grabó freestyles de los raperos del Southside, la Screwed Up Click (Fat Pat, Lil’ Keke, Big Hawk, Big Moe, Big Pokey, E.S.G., Trae, Devin the Dude). Llegaba gente de todo el estado a esperar horas en su casa por una cinta, y abrió Screwed Up Records & Tapes. Hubo quien creció sin oír los discos a velocidad normal. Murió en 2000, con veintinueve años, de sobredosis de codeína: ningún DJ ha tenido tanto impacto en su comunidad.

influences.name: Houston: Rap-A-Lot, Geto Boys y la economía independiente

refs.q: There’s better DJs than DJ Screw. There’s bigger DJs than DJ Screw. But worldwide, there’s never been a DJ that had a bigger impact on his own community than DJ Screw. No one.
refs.para: Matt Sonzala (journalist, Houston): There’s better DJs than DJ Screw. There’s bigger DJs than DJ Screw. But worldwide, there’s never been a DJ that had a bigger impact on his own community than DJ Screw. No one.

refs.q: There were people who literally grew up not hearing albums regular-speed.
refs.para: Matt Sonzala (journalist, Houston): Most people, the first time they heard Screw, didn’t like it. But if you lived in Texas at that time, Screw became an undeniable force. There were people who literally grew up not hearing albums regular-speed. They grew up with slowed-down DJ Screw mixes being the norm.

podcast.title: Inspiration for Witchhouse Atmosphere
podcast.body: Witchhouse producers adapted the core technique of Chopped & Screwed—slowing sounds to induce a near-narcotic state—to serve a different purpose: invoking a ghostly atmosphere. "Estos productores de sensibilidad oscura vieron que esa misma técnica de ralentizar los sonidos para inducir un estado casi narcótico, podían plearse también para invocar una atmósfera fantasma."

srcs.episode: Witch House: Cuando internet inventó su género maldito

podcast.title: Origin and Naming Convention
podcast.body: This subgenre of hip hop originated in Houston, Texas, through the experiments of DJ Screw in the early 1990s. The name "Chopin Escriu" (Chopped and Screwed) reflects its core techniques: "Chop" refers to the cuts, repetitions, and jumps in phrases, while "Screw" denotes the dragged, low-pitched, and slowed tempo. "Asinació el Chopin Escriu, Chop por los cortes, repeticiones y saltos que hacían las frases, como citrociar a las canciones, y escribute por el tiempo arrastrado y grave."

srcs.episode: ¿Por qué el Slowed & Reverb y los Speed Up están rompiendo YT y TikTok?

podcast.title: Origin and Technique
podcast.body: Chopped & Screwed was a G-Hop scene prominent in Houston during the 1990s, originated by the legendary DJ e-Screw. The technique involved drastically slowing down beats, repeating fragments of songs, and rapping in a drawn-out, almost somnambulant way, creating a hypnotic and nearly narcotic effect. "El Chopin e-Screwed fue una escena de G-Hop que fue la profeición Houston durante los años 90. Originada por el legendario DJ e-Screw, esta técnica consistía en ralentizar trásticamente los debates, repetir fragmentos de canciones y rapear de forma restaurada, casi son ámbola, hasta lograr un efecto inmótico y casi narcótico."

srcs.episode: Witch House: Cuando internet inventó su género maldito

podcast.title: Origin in Houston
podcast.body: In Houston, the rap scene became deeply bass-heavy and slow, giving rise to chopped & screwed music. This style was strongly linked to the use of narcotics, particularly "purple drank" (a codeine-based drink). "En Houston por el contrario, la escena se vuelve profundamente besada y lenta, dando pie al Chopin a Escriuet, muy ligada al uso de narcóticos, en concreto al parpeldrank, y esa bebida con base de codeína."
